text: Day 2. Left foot wound dressed, moderate exudate. Glucose 230 before breakfast, 190 at noon. Breathless on walking to the bathroom; SpO2 91 on air. Furosemide given. Plan: wound care review, repeat glucose, daily weight.

Day 4. Wound edges cleaner, light exudate. Glucose 160 to 180. SpO2 92 to 95 on air. Ankles less swollen. Patient asking about going home. Plan: continue dressings, diabetes education, review for discharge in 48 hours.
Day 1. COPD exacerbation. Productive cough, breathless at rest, SpO2 90 on air, 94 on 2 L oxygen. Nebulisers four times a day. Plan: chest physiotherapy, wean oxygen, review inhaler technique.
Day 3. Off oxygen since this morning, SpO2 93 on air. Cough easing. Walked the corridor twice. Plan: step down nebulisers, home with inhalers if stable tomorrow.
Day 1. Cellulitis of the right leg, redness marked with pen. Temperature 38.2. Pain 5 of 10. Plan: leg elevated, antibiotics as charted, check the mark at the evening round.
Day 2. Redness inside the pen mark, temperature 37.4. Pain 3 of 10. Eating well. Plan: continue, review for oral antibiotics tomorrow.
Day 1. Heart failure decompensation, weight up 3 kg in a week. Short of breath lying flat. Plan: fluid balance chart, daily weight, review medicines with the pharmacist.
Day 3. Weight down 1.8 kg. Sleeping on two pillows instead of four. Plan: continue, heart failure nurse to see before discharge.
